# Synthetic sheets: stage addendum (21 Oct 2026)

Adds seven Form A rows (S01 to S07) to the synthetic handwritten sheet set, and expected stages for the existing hero sheets. The rows exercise the stage signatures in `docs/design/addendum-v3.1.md` §F2. The set is generated by `scripts/make_synthetic_sheets.py`; this file is its spec for the stage work. **The set must be regenerated** (P08 task G1) so the new sheets and a new `expected_stages` field in `manifest.json` exist.

**Synthetic results are a robustness check, never eval 9 accuracy.** Eval 9 uses hand-keyed pilot sheets only.

## New rows

Answers are items 1 to 10 of Form A, in order. Item 6 is the anchor (35, correct on every row).

## What the tests assert

- Each row is classified to its expected stage by `engine/stages.py` (F-a), with the signature generated from the form items, not typed in.
- The signature answer sets are disjoint on every item of Forms A and B (item 6 excluded), apart from the designed PV-HEARD and PV-REVERSE overlap; `docs/evidence/stage_signature_check.md` records the one-off check of the specification.
- The reading pipeline (call 8) reads S01 to S07 as a robustness check on the pipeline and the confirm step; any unsure box goes to the teacher, as with the other sheets.
- No row is a real child's work; every file starts with `SIM_` and the manifest says `synthetic: true`.
